2-6 Hopetoun Street

Dear Admissions Officer,                                                                                 Commented [mg1]: Doctor,


Re: Mr. Julian McDonald, aged 68 years

I am writing to inform you on the status of Mr. McDonald, who is being transferred to your hospital
today following a total left knee replacement operation. Your immediate treatment and care would
be highly appreciated.

Mr. McDonald was admitted on 20/07/2018 to Alfred Hospital for surgery. After the operation, he
was in considerable pain which did not respond to morphine and affected his mobility.
Consequently, he would require physiotherapy as well as occupational therapy home visit to his
caravan where he lives, to assess the adequacy of returning there. He is currently on oxycodone,         Commented [mg2]: suitability
targin, ibuprofen and paracetamol.                                                                       Commented [mg3]: should be in conclusion


Additionally, he experienced significant somnolence and snoring in spite of inadequate analgesia,        Commented [mg4]: Mr. McDonald
necessitating sleep studies to exclude obstructive sleep apnea. He was mildly agitated as well.,
given that he smokes ten cigarettes and consumes up to ten standard drinks daily, . Therefore,           Commented [mg5]: Given
social work as well as drug and alcohol input would be appreciated.

Kindly note that Mr. McDonald is allergic to penicillin, and he is due for systems review in ten days.
A specialist review is scheduled on 07/09/2018.

In light of the above, I would be grateful for your follow up of his condition. Should there be any      Commented [mg6]: Mr. McDonald’s
queries, please do not hesitate to contact me. Please find the attached list of medications.

Yours faithfully,
Doctor
